regions.region: page 9 left column, preparation (19) and following high-loading comparison
regions.finding: Two distinct (R)-1e ZnI2/NaI controls were retained as Scheme 6 equations 3 and 4. They give 162.5 mg/73%/25:1 and 167.0 mg/75%/20:1, respectively, with 99% ee major products. The second paragraph's printed high-loading mass/mmol inconsistency is preserved for review.

The full two-pot CdI2 filtration experiment is the detailed version of Scheme 3 equation 5 and was merged, adding exact quantities, two filtration stages, 4 mL second-stage toluene, 90 °C/5 h, 153.9 mg, 69% isolated yield, and 95% ee.

regions.finding: Bibliography and prior-literature citations only. External papers were not expanded into current-paper reaction records, and no new arrow, table row, or preparative procedure occurs in these regions.

Two directly compared current observations were retained separately: CuBr/(R,Ra)-N-PINAP in 2 mL toluene for 30 min at room temperature formed a yellow clear solution, whereas CuBr/(R,Sa)-N-PINAP under the same conditions formed a pale yellow solid. These are solubility/phase observations, not allenol preparations.
